hero.title: One codebase. Multiple businesses.
hero.subtitle: Multi-rubro PWA boilerplate: configuration, not rewriting. Launch apps for restaurants, clinics, barbershops, gyms and stores in days, not months.

demo.title: Try the Demo by Business Type
demo.subtitle: Select a business type and watch the theme, texts and modules change automatically. Same codebase, different experience.

features.title: Everything you need
features.subtitle: Production-ready base features, configurable via JSON per client.

theming.title: Theme System
theming.desc: Colors, fonts, logo and branding per client via JSON. Instant change without rebuild.

pwa.title: Full PWA
pwa.desc: Service Worker, manifest, offline mode, installable on home screen, push notifications.

i18n.title: Multi-language
i18n.desc: /es /en routing with next-intl. Messages in JSON. Ready for LATAM + US.

performance.title: Performance
performance.desc: SSR/ISR with Next.js 14, image optimization, code splitting, edge caching.

auth.title: Robust Auth
auth.desc: Better Auth with JWT, roles (owner/staff/client), refresh tokens, optional 2FA.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.desc: Plausible/Umami integrated. Custom events per activable module.

stack.title: Tech Stack
stack.subtitle: Proven, typed and maintainable technologies. Chosen for development speed and scalability.
